# MeedyaDL 1.5.0

Two focused improvements: a tool to tidy up older downloads, and a more scannable Activity log.

### What's new

- **"Merge Legacy Folders" tool cleans up old, duplicated album folders.** If you've been downloading since before MeedyaDL 1.4.4, your library may have accumulated sibling folders sitting side by side — for example, `Album` and `Album [Explicit]`. This new tool, found on the Library page, walks you through reconciling those pairs into one canonical folder. It's opt-in and safe: you pick a parent folder, review a preview of exactly what would move where, and nothing happens until you click Execute. It won't merge folders that don't actually match (each pair is cross-checked against the Explicit/Clean rating baked into the audio itself), it renames rather than overwrites on any filename collision, and if both folders have download history recorded, that history is combined rather than lost.
- **The Activity log now colour-codes errors and warnings**, so you can spot trouble at a glance instead of reading every line. Errors (like a failed download or a filesystem error) show in red, warnings (like a music-video lookup failure or a fallback notice) show in amber, and everything else keeps the normal colour. This works automatically in light, dark, high-contrast, and colour-blind themes, including for warnings and errors that come from the downloader engine itself.

### Notes

- Exported activity logs remain plain text for now; colour-coded exports may come later.
